reviews.title: Broaden tested AS2 display and graphics runtime compatibility (T-304)
reviews.summary: Promotes rotated and skewed MovieClip._width and _height getters/setters, MovieClip.lineStyle hairline (thickness == 0) plus pixelHinting/scaleMode/caps/joints/miterLimit, and MovieClip.blendMode string and numeric modes 1..14 including subtract, invert, alpha, erase, and layer across native Rust and HTML5 Canvas.

entries.note: Reads and assigns parent-space AABB _width across rotated and skewed MovieClips, updating _xscale/_yscale cleanly.
Reads and assigns parent-space AABB _height across rotated and skewed MovieClips, updating _xscale/_yscale cleanly.
Supports hairline (thickness == 0), pixelHinting, scaleMode, caps, joints, and miterLimit across native Rust and HTML5 Canvas.
Supports string and numeric blend modes 1..14 including subtract, invert, alpha, erase, and layer across native Rust and HTML5 Canvas.
